name: Titanium.UI.Android
summary:
The Android-specific UI capabilities. All properties, methods and events in this namespace will
only work on Android systems.

#### Drawer Layout

The drawer-layout components acts as a top-level container for window content that allows
for interactive "drawer" views to be pulled out from one or both vertical edges of the window.
It is represented by a `centerView` and optional `leftView` and `rightView` components that
can be swiped in and out with additional configuration and transitions. Learn more about
drawer-layouts in it's dedicated [Titanium.UI.Android.DrawerLayout](api:Titanium.UI.Android.DrawerLayout) docs.

examples.title: Android Preferences Example
examples.code:
Create preferences interface for the application.

#### `app.js`
``` js
var button = Ti.UI.createButton({
  title:	'Click to Open Preferences'
});
button.addEventListener('click', function() {
  Ti.API.info('Current value for editText: ' + Ti.App.Properties.getString('editText'));
  Ti.UI.Android.openPreferences();
});
currentWindow.add(button);
```

#### `platform/android/res/xml/preferences.xml`
``` xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<PreferenceScreen xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    android:title="Preferences">
  <PreferenceScreen
      android:title="Misc. Preferences"
      android:summary="Click to see more options">
    <EditTextPreference
      android:title="Edit Text Preference"
      android:summary="You may enter a string"
      android:defaultValue=""
      android:key="editText" />
  </PreferenceScreen>
  <PreferenceCategory android:title="Category One">
    <CheckBoxPreference
      android:title="CheckBox Preference"
      android:defaultValue="false"
      android:summary="You may enter a boolean"
      android:key="checkbox" />
    <RingtonePreference
      android:title="Ringtone Preference"
      android:summary="You may pick a ringtone"
      android:defaultValue=""
      android:key="ringtone" />
  </PreferenceCategory>
  <PreferenceCategory android:title="Category Two">
    <ListPreference
      android:title="List Preference"
      android:summary="You may chose from multiple choices"
      android:key="list"
    android:entries="@array/listNames"
    android:entryValues="@array/listValues"
    />
  </PreferenceCategory>
</PreferenceScreen>
```

#### `platform/android/res/values/array/array.xml`
``` xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<resources>
  <string-array name="listNames">
    <item>5 Minutes</item>
    <item>10 Minutes</item>
    <item>15 Minutes</item>
    <item>30 Minutes</item>
    <item>60 Minutes</item>
  </string-array>
  <string-array name="listValues">
    <item>5</item>
    <item>10</item>
    <item>15</item>
    <item>30</item>
    <item>60</item>
  </string-array>
</resources>
```

properties.name: FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
properties.summary: Flag allowing window to extend into the status bar and navigation bar.
properties.description:
When assigned to [Window.windowFlags](api:Titanium.UI.Window#windowFlags), this flag will make the
window ignore the system's insets such as the top status bar and bottom navigation bar so that
they overlap the window. The system may make the status bar and navigation bar completely transparent,
but this behavior is not guaranteed to happen.

When using this flag, it's also recommended to set the
[Window.extendSafeArea](api:Titanium.UI.Window#extendSafeArea) property to `true`.

Warning: Using this flag causes [Window.safeAreaPadding](api:Titanium.UI.Window#safeAreaPadding)
to return all zeros. This flag also breaks keyboard `adjustPan` support.

properties.name: FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_NAVIGATION
properties.summary: Window flag which makes the Android system's navigation bar semi-transparent.
properties.description:
When assigned to [Titanium.UI.Window.windowFlags](api:Titanium.UI.Window#windowFlags), this flag will make the Android
system's bottom navigation bar semi-transparent. This flag will only work if you also set the
[Window.extendSafeArea](api:Titanium.UI.Window#extendSafeArea) property to `true`.

This flag is only supported by Android 4.4 and newer OS versions. This flag is ignored on older versions.
On Android 4.4, navigation bar can only be translucent in portrait mode while newer OS versions support
this flag for all orientations.

properties.name: FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_STATUS
properties.summary: Window flag which makes the Android system's top status bar semi-transparent.
properties.description:
When assigned to [Titanium.UI.Window.windowFlags](api:Titanium.UI.Window#windowFlags), this flag will make the Android
system's top status bar semi-transparent. This flag will only work if you also set the
[Titanium.UI.Window.extendSafeArea](api:Titanium.UI.Window#extendSafeArea) property to `true`.

This flag is only supported by Android 4.4 and newer OS versions. This flag is ignored on older versions.

properties.name: GRAVITY_AXIS_CLIP
properties.summary: Raw bit controlling whether the right/bottom edge is clipped to its container, based on the gravity direction being applied.

properties.name: GRAVITY_AXIS_PULL_AFTER
properties.summary: Raw bit controlling how the right/bottom edge is placed.

properties.name: GRAVITY_AXIS_PULL_BEFORE
properties.summary: Raw bit controlling how the left/top edge is placed.

properties.name: GRAVITY_AXIS_SPECIFIED
properties.summary: Raw bit indicating the gravity for an axis has been specified.

properties.name: GRAVITY_AXIS_X_SHIFT
properties.summary: Bits defining the horizontal axis.

properties.name: GRAVITY_AXIS_Y_SHIFT
properties.summary: Bits defining the vertical axis.

properties.name: GRAVITY_BOTTOM
properties.summary: Push object to the bottom of its container, not changing its size.

properties.name: GRAVITY_CENTER
properties.summary: Place the object in the center of its container in both the vertical and horizontal axis, not changing its size.

properties.name: GRAVITY_CENTER_HORIZONTAL
properties.summary: Place object in the horizontal center of its container, not changing its size.

properties.name: GRAVITY_CENTER_VERTICAL
properties.summary: Place object in the vertical center of its container, not changing its size.

properties.name: GRAVITY_CLIP_HORIZONTAL
properties.summary: Flag to clip the edges of the object to its container along the horizontal axis.

properties.name: GRAVITY_CLIP_VERTICAL
properties.summary: Flag to clip the edges of the object to its container along the vertical axis.

properties.name: GRAVITY_DISPLAY_CLIP_HORIZONTAL
properties.summary: Special constant to enable clipping to an overall display along the horizontal dimension.

properties.name: GRAVITY_DISPLAY_CLIP_VERTICAL
properties.summary: Special constant to enable clipping to an overall display along the vertical dimension.

properties.name: GRAVITY_END
properties.summary: Push object to x-axis position at the end of its container, not changing its size.

properties.name: GRAVITY_FILL
properties.summary: Grow the horizontal and vertical size of the object if needed so it completely fills its container.

properties.name: GRAVITY_FILL_HORIZONTAL
properties.summary: Grow the horizontal size of the object if needed so it completely fills its container.

properties.name: GRAVITY_FILL_VERTICAL
properties.summary: Grow the vertical size of the object if needed so it completely fills its container.

properties.name: GRAVITY_HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK
properties.summary: Binary mask to get the absolute horizontal gravity of a gravity.

properties.name: GRAVITY_LEFT
properties.summary: Push object to the left of its container, not changing its size.

properties.name: GRAVITY_NO_GRAVITY
properties.summary: Constant indicating that no gravity has been set

properties.name: GRAVITY_RELATIVE_HORIZONTAL_GRAVITY_MASK
properties.summary: Binary mask for the horizontal gravity and script specific direction bit.

properties.name: GRAVITY_RELATIVE_LAYOUT_DIRECTION
properties.summary: Raw bit controlling whether the layout direction is relative or not (GRAVITY_START/GRAVITY_END instead of absolute GRAVITY_LEFT/GRAVITY_RIGHT).

properties.name: GRAVITY_RIGHT
properties.summary: Push object to the right of its container, not changing its size.

properties.name: GRAVITY_START
properties.summary: Push object to x-axis position at the start of its container, not changing its size.

properties.name: GRAVITY_TOP
properties.summary: Push object to the top of its container, not changing its size.

properties.name: GRAVITY_VERTICAL_GRAVITY_MASK
properties.summary: Binary mask to get the vertical gravity of a gravity.

properties.name: OVER_SCROLL_ALWAYS
properties.summary: Always allow a user to over-scroll this view, provided it is a view that can scroll.
properties.description:
Use this with the following properties - [Titanium.UI.ScrollableView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollableView#overScrollMode), [Titanium.UI.ScrollView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollView#overScrollMode),

Only applicable when [Titanium.Platform.Android.API_LEVEL](api:Titanium.Platform.Android#API_LEVEL) is 9 or above.

properties.name: OVER_SCROLL_IF_CONTENT_SCROLLS

properties.description:
Use this with the following properties - [Titanium.UI.ScrollableView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollableView#overScrollMode), [Titanium.UI.ScrollView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollView#overScrollMode),
[Titanium.UI.TableView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.TableView#overScrollMode) and [Titanium.UI.WebView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#overScrollMode).

Only applicable when [Titanium.Platform.Android.API_LEVEL](api:Titanium.Platform.Android#API_LEVEL) is 9 or above.

properties.name: OVER_SCROLL_NEVER
properties.summary: Never allow a user to over-scroll this view.
properties.description:
Use this with the following properties - [Titanium.UI.ScrollableView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollableView#overScrollMode), [Titanium.UI.ScrollView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.ScrollView#overScrollMode),
[Titanium.UI.TableView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.TableView#overScrollMode) and [Titanium.UI.WebView.overScrollMode](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#overScrollMode).

properties.name: SCROLL_FLAG_ENTER_ALWAYS
properties.summary: When entering (scrolling on screen) the view will scroll on any downwards scroll event, regardless of whether the scrolling view is also scrolling. This is commonly referred to as the 'quick return' pattern.

properties.name: SCROLL_FLAG_ENTER_ALWAYS_COLLAPSED
properties.summary: An additional flag for 'enterAlways' which modifies the returning view to only initially scroll back to it's collapsed height. Once the scrolling view has reached the end of it's scroll range, the remainder of this view will be scrolled into view. The collapsed height is defined by the view's minimum height.

properties.name: SCROLL_FLAG_EXIT_UNTIL_COLLAPSED
properties.summary: When exiting (scrolling off screen) the view will be scrolled until it is 'collapsed'. The collapsed height is defined by the view's minimum height.

properties.name: SCROLL_FLAG_NO_SCROLL
properties.summary: Disable scrolling on the view. This flag should not be combined with any of the other scroll flags.

properties.name: SCROLL_FLAG_SCROLL
properties.summary: The view will be scroll in direct relation to scroll events. This flag needs to be set for any of the other flags to take effect. If any sibling views before this one do not have this flag, then this value has no effect.

properties.name: SCROLL_FLAG_SNAP
properties.summary: Upon a scroll ending, if the view is only partially visible then it will be snapped and scrolled to its closest edge. For example, if the view only has its bottom 25% displayed, it will be scrolled off screen completely. Conversely, if its bottom 75% is visible then it will be scrolled fully into view.

properties.name: SCROLL_FLAG_SNAP_MARGINS
properties.summary: An additional flag to be used with 'snap'. If set, the view will be snapped to its top and bottom margins, as opposed to the edges of the view itself.

properties.name: SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_NOTHING
properties.summary: The window will not be resized, and it will not be panned to make its focus visible.
properties.description: Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.windowSoftInputMode](api:Titanium.UI.Window#windowSoftInputMode) property.

properties.name: SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_PAN
properties.summary:
Pan the current heavyweight window when the input method (ie software keyboard) is shown, to
ensure that its contents are not obscured.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.windowSoftInputMode](api:Titanium.UI.Window#windowSoftInputMode) property.

One of the group of soft input adjustment constants,
[SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_UNSPECIFIED](api:Titanium.UI.Android#SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_UNSPECIFIED),
[SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE](api:Titanium.UI.Android#SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE),
and [SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_PAN](api:Titanium.UI.Android#SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_PAN).

properties.name: SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE
properties.summary:
Resize the current heavyweight window when the input method (ie software keyboard) is shown,
to ensure that its contents are not obscured.
properties.description:
Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.windowSoftInputMode](api:Titanium.UI.Window#windowSoftInputMode) property.

One of the group of soft input adjustment constants,
[SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_UNSPECIFIED](api:Titanium.UI.Android#SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_UNSPECIFIED),
[SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE](api:Titanium.UI.Android#SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE),

properties.name: SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_UNSPECIFIED
properties.summary:
Use the system-default behavior to determine how the soft input area (ie software keyboard)
is accomodated by the current heavyweight window when it receives focus (default.)
properties.description:
Depends on the `AndroidManifest.xml` setting if defined or system-default otherwise to
determine how to accomodate the soft keyboard when visible.

Used with the [Titanium.UI.Window.windowSoftInputMode](api:Titanium.UI.Window#windowSoftInputMode) property.

[SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_UNSPECIFIED](api:Titanium.UI.Android#SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_UNSPECIFIED),
[SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE](api:Titanium.UI.Android#SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE),
and [SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_PAN](api:Titanium.UI.Android#SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_PAN).

properties.description: Use with the [Titanium.UI.Switch.style](api:Titanium.UI.Switch#style) property.

properties.name: TAB_MODE_FIXED
properties.summary: Set the TabGroup tab mode to fixed (default).

properties.name: TAB_MODE_SCROLLABLE
properties.summary: Set the TabGroup tab mode to scrollable.

properties.name: TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION
properties.summary: TabGroup style taking advantage of a bottom navigation controller for switching between tabs.

properties.name: TABS_STYLE_DEFAULT
properties.summary: The default TabGroup style that places the Tabs bellow the ActionBar and above the Window content.

properties.name: TRANSITION_CHANGE_BOUNDS
properties.summary: Captures layout bounds of target views before and after the scene change and animates those changes during the transition.
properties.description:
Use this only for shared element transition.
Refers to [ChangeBounds](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/ChangeBounds.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_CHANGE_CLIP_BOUNDS
properties.summary: Captures the clip bounds before and after the scene change and animates those changes during the transition.
properties.description:
Use this only for shared element transition.
Refers to [ChangeClipBounds](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/ChangeClipBounds.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_CHANGE_IMAGE_TRANSFORM
properties.summary: Captures an ImageView's matrix before and after the scene change and animates it during the transition.
properties.description:
Use this only for shared element transition.
Refers to [ChangeImageTransform](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/ChangeImageTransform.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_CHANGE_TRANSFORM
properties.summary: Captures scale and rotation for Views before and after the scene change and animates those changes during the transition.
properties.description:
Use this only for shared element transition.
Refers to [ChangeTransform](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/ChangeTransform.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_EXPLODE
properties.summary: Moves views in or out from the edges of the scene.
properties.description:
Use this only for activity transition.
Refers to [Explode](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/Explode.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_FADE_IN
properties.summary: Fades in the views.
properties.description:
Use this only for activity transition.
Refers to [Fade](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/Fade.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_FADE_OUT
properties.summary: Fades out the views.
properties.description:
Use this only for activity transition.
Refers to [Fade](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/Fade.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_NONE
properties.summary: Resets transition to platform default.
properties.description: Can be used with activity and shared element transtion.

properties.name: TRANSITION_SLIDE_BOTTOM
properties.summary: Moves views to bottom.
properties.description:
Use this only for activity transition.
Refers to [Slide](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/Slide.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_SLIDE_LEFT
properties.summary: Moves views to left.
properties.description:
Use this only for activity transition.
Refers to [Slide](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/Slide.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_SLIDE_RIGHT
properties.summary: Moves views to right.
properties.description:
Use this only for activity transition.
Refers to [Slide](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/Slide.html) transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_SLIDE_TOP
properties.summary: Moves views to top.
properties.description:
Use this only for activity transition.
Refers to [Slide](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/transition/Slide.html) transition.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_LOAD_CACHE_ELSE_NETWORK
properties.summary: Use with [WebView.cacheMode](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#cacheMode) to override how the cache is used in a web view.
properties.description: Use cached resources when they're available, even when they're expired. Otherwise load resources via network.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_LOAD_CACHE_ONLY
properties.summary: Use with [WebView.cacheMode](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#cacheMode) to override how the cache is used in a web view.
properties.description: Don't use network, load from the cache only.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_LOAD_DEFAULT
properties.summary: Use with [WebView.cacheMode](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#cacheMode) to override how the cache is used in a web view.
properties.description: This is the default cache usage mode.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_LOAD_NO_CACHE
properties.summary: Use with [WebView.cacheMode](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#cacheMode) to override how the cache is used in a web view.
properties.description: Don't use cache, load from the network.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_PLUGINS_OFF
properties.summary: Use with [WebView.pluginState](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#pluginState) to disable plugins in a web view.
properties.description:
Content that requires a plugin, is not loaded, and any
alternative content is displayed instead.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_PLUGINS_ON
properties.summary: Use with [WebView.pluginState](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#pluginState) to enable plugins in a web view.
properties.description:
Content that requires a plugin,, is always loaded, whether or not a plugin is
available for the content.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_PLUGINS_ON_DEMAND
properties.summary: Display a placeholder and only load plugins when user selects it.
properties.description:
Content that requires a plugin, is replaced by a placeholder. When
the user clicks on the placeholder, the plugin is loaded and the content is displayed.

Use with [WebView.pluginState](api:Titanium.UI.WebView#pluginState) to load plugins on demand.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_SCROLLBARS_DEFAULT
properties.summary: Show horizontal and vertical scrollbar in a Ti.UI.WebView.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_SCROLLBARS_HIDE_ALL
properties.summary: Hide all scrollbars in a Ti.UI.WebView.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_SCROLLBARS_HIDE_HORIZONTAL
properties.summary: Hide horizontal scrollbar in a Ti.UI.WebView.

properties.name: WEBVIEW_SCROLLBARS_HIDE_VERTICAL
properties.summary: Hide vertical scrollbar in a Ti.UI.WebView.

methods.name: getColorResource
methods.summary: Returns a <Ti.Color> instance for a color defined by the system or user resources (colors.xml)
methods.description:
This method allows converting a known color resource id or short name to an actual color instance.

The resource id values can be accessed via [Titanium.Android.R.color](api:Titanium.Android.R#color) and <Titanium.App.Android.R.color> properties.

See the official Android Developer documentation for
the [R.color](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/R.color) constants.

parameters.name: resourceIdOrColorName
parameters.summary: integer resource id for a color, or the name of the color defined in the application resources (colors.xml).

methods.name: harmonizedColor
methods.description:
Shifts the hue of the input color towards the hue of colorPrimary and returns a new color
as a hex string. Usage: `Ti.UI.Android.harmonizedColor("#ff0000");`

methods.name: hideSoftKeyboard
methods.description:
Be aware that it is not currently possible in the native Android API to detect that the
keyboard is already visible or to globally show the keyboard.

methods.summary: Moves the app to the background

methods.name: openPreferences
methods.summary:
Opens an application preferences dialog, using the native Android system settings interface,
defined by the platform-specific `preferences.xml` and `array.xml` files.
methods.description:
The preferences configuration files must be created in the project folders,
`platform/android/res/xml/preferences.xml` and `platform/android/res/values/array/array.xml`.

The preferences values can be accessed via [Titanium.App.Properties](api:Titanium.App.Properties).

See the example for a demonstration, and the official Android Developer documentation for
the [preferences.xml](https://developer.android.com/guide/topics/ui/settings.html#DefiningPrefs)
format.
